name: session-switches
description: A Builder chat's reasoning and speed switches and steering with no live run, through the owner (stand-in model, which advertises no efforts or speeds): the reasoning refusals in Python's order (no effort, no session, an empty or unknown scope, a non-text effort, an unknown session, an effort the model does not offer, now and as the next reply), the special values accepted for the chat and the next reply and cleared again; the speed refusals, `standard` and `null` saved; steering's refusals (no text, an empty or over-long text, no session or message id, and the loop's own with no live run), with the chat index showing the saved efforts; then shut down.
